description: This file defines the AOS_Quotes class, which extends the AOS_Quotes_sugar class. It handles operations related to quotes in the SuiteCRM system, including saving quotes with logic to assign a quote number, and marking quotes as deleted along with their associated line items.

classes.name: AOS_Quotes
classes.description: Class representing Quotes in SuiteCRM, extending the base sugar class and adding custom save and delete behaviors.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that calls the parent constructor.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Overrides the save method to assign a quote number if necessary, clean up POST data, and save associated group data.

methods.name: mark_deleted
methods.description: Marks the current quote and its related line items as deleted.
